chain_words.nuance: requires effort and skill to succeed
takes a lot of time, energy and attention
formal, very hard and tiring over a long period
extremely exhausting, pushing someone to their limits

explanation: These words all describe something that is not easy to do, moving from a slightly complicated task to an extremely exhausting one.

usage_notes.difference: 'Challenging' stresses the mental effort needed to succeed; 'demanding' stresses the time, energy and constant attention that something requires.
